model.name: Merge Save writes to the diff's repo/current branch (no 404) + center header shows filename@currentBranch
model.description: The 3-way merge SAVE writes to the file in the DIFF'S repo on the CURRENT CHECKED-OUT branch/commit - no 404. BUG (v0.7.60): with all conflicts resolved ('0/61 open conflicts, modified'), Save -> 'save failed (404)'. ROOT (expert-measured): the save PUT hits the MAIN/rawbin repo while the diff file (e.g. otmux) lives in the OOSH repo -> the write path does not exist -> 404. This is the SAME wrong-repo root as the C read-fix (R30.6.7). FIX: route the save PUT through the diff's repo KEY (RepoRegistry, mirroring the read path) so it writes to the correct repo/branch; the server /api/files PUT endpoint accepts ?repo=<key> and resolves the write there (server-side - needs a restart). ALSO: the CENTER pane header shows 'filename@currentBranch' (e.g. otmux@<branch>) reflecting WHERE the save writes. Client-facing -> version-bump + atomic deploy (R30.28).

model.crossRefNote: Save side of the repo-targeting the C read-fix (R30.6.7 RepoRegistry) established: the read path routes by repo key; R30.38 routes the SAVE (write) the same way so a file in a non-rawbin repo (OOSH/otmux) saves without 404. IMPL-EDIT to RbDiffEditor.save (11a8ea6e) + the server /api/files PUT (accept ?repo=<key>) + the center-pane header (mountThreePane d9223804 / a new header method). crossRef R30.9 (merge/save) + R30.10 (file history, repo-aware). Architect derive-confirms the method-set; I re-point to built.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The merge Save routes the PUT through the DIFF'S repo (the repo the file lives in, e.g. OOSH for 'otmux'), NOT the main/rawbin repo, writing to the file in the CURRENT CHECKED-OUT branch/commit. A file in a non-rawbin repo saves WITHOUT a 404.

The server save PUT endpoint (/api/files PUT) accepts the repo KEY (?repo=<key>, R30.6.7 RepoRegistry) and resolves the write path in that repo - mirroring the C read-path fix. (Server-side change -> requires a server restart; expert authority.)
The CENTER pane header shows 'filename@currentBranch' (e.g. otmux@<currentBranch>) reflecting WHERE the save writes.
With all conflicts resolved, pressing Save SUCCEEDS (HTTP 200, file written) - no 'save failed (404)'.

GATE on the REAL deep-link (e.g. /edit/otmux?repo=oosh&left=<ref>&right=<ref>&3way=1): resolve conflicts -> Save succeeds (no 404), the file is written to the OOSH repo's checked-out branch, and the center header reads otmux@<branch>. Verified live; version-bump + atomic deploy (R30.28).
